title: DocsLit page frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter at the top of each Markdown page in docs/. Only title is strongly recommended.

title.description: Page title. Used for the heading, browser tab, sidebar label, search index and llms.txt. Every page should have one.

description.description: Short summary used for SEO meta tags, search, llms.txt and the generated Open Graph image.

sidebar_title.description: Shorter label for the sidebar when the full title is too long.

sidebar.description: Set to false to leave this page out of an autogenerated sidebar.

sidebar_position.description: Sort position within an autogenerated sidebar group (lower first).

tag.description: Category badge shown next to the page title (Guide, Reference, Tutorial, API...).

readtime.description: Reading time shown in the page header, for example "3 min read". Must be a string.

updated.description: Last-updated text shown in the page metadata, for example "May 2026".

date.description: Publication date used by the RSS/Atom feeds (falls back to updated, then published).

component.description: Technology or category label shown in the page metadata, for example "React" or "CLI".

icon.description: Lucide icon name for the page. Must be a non-empty string.

order.description: Reserved ordering hint (accepted by validate; sidebar order comes from docslit.json or sidebar_position).

draft.description: Hide the page from the built site and sidebar. Still visible in `docslit dev`.

redirect.description: Redirect visitors to another page or URL, for example "/new-page". Emits redirect stubs on build.

layout.description: Set to "api" for API reference pages (three-column layout with examples panel). Set automatically by `docslit openapi scaffold`.

ogImage.description: Set to false to skip the generated Open Graph image for this page.

feedback.description: Set to false to hide the page feedback widget on this page.

attributes.description: Page-level variables for {{NAME}} placeholders; override global attributes from docslit.json.
